agentic_repository_design.target_operator: Autonomous AI Agent & Human Peer Programmers
agentic_repository_design.philosophy: Agentic Repository Design: Strict Inclusion Hierarchy where .git_github ⊂ .git_github_context ⊂ .git_mgit, governing public code releases, private cloud audit backups, and local workspace memory.

level_1_github_public.contents: Clean production web substrate (kairos_mgit/), 101 courseware, Edge Functions, public event routes, and elevated Chronos public goods.
level_1_github_public.security: 100% secret-free. Excludes .localonly files and private Chronos snapshots.

level_2_github_context.contents: Includes EVERYTHING in .git_github PLUS chronos_mgit/ time-sharded memory snapshots, execution audit logs, WeDo manifests, and raw transcripts.

level_3_local_mgit.scope: Complete Super-Set of All Workspace Files
level_3_local_mgit.contents: Includes EVERYTHING in .git_github_context PLUS local .localonly configuration files, local EVM wallets, staging logs, and internal workspace state.

localonly_pattern.description: Any file containing local configs, secrets, private keys, or staging logs must append .localonly before its extension (e.g. config.localonly.js, wallet.localonly.json).
localonly_pattern.linter_rule: Pre-commit secret scanner blocks public .git_github commits if keys are found in non-.localonly files.
